pages.title: Restore Deleted Items From Site Collection Recycle Bin
pages.description: Learn how to manage the SharePoint Site Collection recycle bin for SharePoint Online.
pages.about: This page explains how the two-stage SharePoint Recycle Bin works — items deleted from a site go to the first-stage Recycle Bin, and when deleted from there, move to the second-stage (site collection) Recycle Bin. It covers how site collection administrators can restore items from both stages, including restoring entire site collections via the SharePoint admin center.
changes: New documentation page added covering the SharePoint site collection Recycle Bin restore process
Explains first-stage vs second-stage Recycle Bin behavior, including storage quota implications
Provides step-by-step restore instructions for modern team sites, communication sites, and classic sites
Includes guidance on restoring entire site collections via the SharePoint admin center for global/SharePoint admins
